mapper.sql: a.id, a.shop_code, a.accountcode as account_code, a.accountname as account_name, a.accountfullname as account_full_name, a.accountno as account_no, a.bankname as bank_name, a.currentbalance as current_balance, a.currency, a.isactive as is_active, a.remark, a.createuser as create_user, a.createtime as create_time, a.updateuser as update_user, a.updatetime as update_time
select , cu.nick_name as create_user_name from sdsshop.u_f_account a left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = a.createuser
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_f_account( shop_code, accountcode, accountname, accountfullname, accountno, bankname, currentbalance, currency, isactive, remark, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{accountFullName}, #{accountNo}, #{bankName}, 0, #{currency}, coalesce(#{isActive}, 1), #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_f_account set accountname = #{accountName}, accountfullname = #{accountFullName}, accountno = #{accountNo}, bankname = #{bankName}, currency = #{currency}, isactive = coalesce(#{isActive}, 1), remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and id = #{id}
